name: tas-studio-tools
description: Dev-only tooling for the SNES TAS Studio: icon generation and headless smoke tests. Not shipped with the app.
_feat003_note: FEAT-003 reworked the headless harnesses for THE GREAT REVERSAL (single-thread, main-thread rAF). The Web Worker is gone: tas-engine.js is now a DIRECT single-thread engine owning one EmuCoreRunner + one InputResolver + one GLPresenter driven by ONE requestAnimationFrame loop. The DOM/engine harnesses (engine-smoke/studio-dom/mobile-smoke/engine-determinism) now drive the REAL engine + REAL runner + REAL resolver against a CONTROLLABLE fake requestAnimationFrame + a MOCK libretro core via tools/single-thread-harness.mjs (which replaced the deleted tools/mock-worker.mjs). engine-smoke asserts one retro_run + one present per rAF at 1x, ~half at 0.5x, bounded catch-up, frame-advance-exactly-one, and no worker. engine-determinism.test.mjs (replacing the deleted worker-boundary.test.mjs) is the authoritative determinism + save/load + core-switch test (real runner + real resolver + mock core): frame N runs with exactly (log.getMask(N)|liveMask)>>>0. runloop.test.mjs retargets the accumulator/pacing assertions to the single-thread engine and adds one-present-per-rAF-under-bursts proofs. no-worker-check.mjs is a grep-proof that fails if new Worker/postMessage/MessageChannel/transferControlToOffscreen/OffscreenCanvas appears as live app code (tas-engine.js/app.js) and asserts emu-worker.js is gone. tools/emu-worker.test.mjs was deleted (worker retired). tools/bridge-profile.mjs was repurposed from the cross-thread present bridge into a single-thread steady-state per-frame allocation profiler. precache-check pins tas-studio-v23 and no longer lists emu-worker.js. THE BLINDFOLD TEST (no-present diagnostic) adds coverage in engine-smoke.mjs (section (i)): blindfold defaults OFF; ON performs ZERO texSubImage2D/texImage2D/drawArrays and ZERO putImageData on the 2D fallback across many rAF turns while retro_run still advances ~1 frame per rAF, the framebuffer DECODE still runs, onFrame still fires and the real FpsMeter still reports a rate; the toggle flips at runtime (ON->OFF->ON) with the banner videoPath suffix + Present field following; and the ?blindfold=1 / ?noPresent=1 URL parser is unit-tested. studio-dom + mobile-smoke cover the #blindfold-toggle UI control and the banner Present field.
